newsitem.title: USA: Integrated pays $21 mln to Coram.
newsitem.headline: Integrated pays $21 mln to Coram.

text.p: Integrated Health Services Inc said Tuesday it paid Coram Healthcare Corp $21 million as part of a settlement accord for the termination of their planned merger.
The company said in a statement that under the terms of the deal, IHS has paid Coram $21 million to cover fees and expenses
"Each party has released the other from any and all claims, liabilities and other obligations in connection with the merger agreement," the statement said.
"This payment will not affect the company's earnings before non-recurring items."
Integrated Health Services and Coram terminated their merger agreement last month.
